subject: Private deployment: circuit-breaker maintenance orchestration & pin strategy
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Samantha Reyes <samantha@acmeai.com>
Cc: ops@acmeai.com
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment: circuit-breaker maintenance orchestration & pin strategy

Hi all,

We're kicking off planning for the Private (VPC/on-prem) patch wave targeting runtime v1.2.x the week of July 12. Goal: apply critical CVE fixes and runtime perf improvements while preserving customer pinning and offering a fast rollback path. Draft notes attached: patch_manifest_v1.2.pdf and private_maintenance_runbook_v3.md.

Key asks up front:
- Acme: confirm acceptable maintenance windows (we've suggested 10:00PM–2:00AM PT weekdays or a full weekend slot).
- Engineering: quick review of the proposed circuit-breaker sequence below and sign off on rollback triggers.
- Security: confirm audit/logging and KMS rotation steps for the window.

Planned orchestration outline (high-level):
1) Stage in canary pool (single rack) with version pinned per tenant in the control plane.
2) Run smoke + perf canaries (2 hours) with circuit-breaker gates: 5xx rate > 0.5% or median latency increase > 25% triggers halt and auto-rollback.
3) If canary green, batch rollout in 20% increments with prefix cache warm-up and KV replay disabled for the first two batches.
4) Post-rollout regression tests and 24-hour watch window; point-in-time logs captured to secure bucket.

Attached checklist includes a "circuit-breaker" matrix and exact Prometheus alerts mapped to rollback actions. I'm proposing a tentative maintenance window: July 13 22:00 PT — July 14 02:00 PT (weekday late-night) or July 17 02:00–10:00 PT (weekend long).

Notes on pinning: we will honor customer-specified model/runtime pins by adding a compatibility shim for any pinned tenants (these tenants are not automatically rolled unless they opt in). We will surface a per-tenant opt-in URL in the console during the maintenance announcement.

Please review and reply with: preferred window, any compliance blockers, and a single point of contact for pre- and post-window escalation.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Product & Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: patch_manifest_v1.2.pdf (12 pages), private_maintenance_runbook_v3.md (4 pages), canary-checklist.xlsx (3 sheets)

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Samantha Reyes <samantha@acmeai.com>
Cc: ops@acmeai.com
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment: circuit-breaker maintenance orchestration & pin strategy

Alex / team,

Quick technical read — overall approach looks good. A few concrete notes I want captured in the runbook before we lock windows:

- Pin implementation: we'll add an explicit tenant metadata flag (runtime_pin: v1.1.9) that the control plane honors; pinned tenants will be skipped in the bulk rollout and listed in the "skipped-tenants" artifact.
- KV cache warm-up: for batches 3+ we will enable prefix/KV warming with a conservative concurrency cap (max 50 concurrent fills) to avoid thundering-herd.
- Rollback path: my preferred immediate rollback is to: 1) flip the routing tag to previous image in the serving pool, 2) restore KV prefix from snapshot (last-good), 3) restart actors with previous kernel. We need automation for steps 1 & 3; step 2 is manual unless snapshot exists.
- Circuit-breaker thresholds: make the 5xx threshold tenant-aware (e.g., higher tolerance for large-batched throughput tenants). I'll add a script to map tenant SLA to threshold.
- DB migration: none planned. If we need to, we run migrations only in a single control-plane node and gate with feature flags.

I'll update private_maintenance_runbook_v3.md with these details (pushing v3.1) and add a checklist entry that the rollback automation must be rehearsed in stage 48 hours prior.

Dev
Senior SRE
Redwood Inference

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the heads-up and the clear plan. A couple of items from Acme's side:
- Downtime constraints: our busiest window is 01:00–05:00 PT weekdays (we get background batch LLM scoring). The weekday late-night slot you proposed overlaps OK but please avoid any >30m single-tenant cold starts.
- Compliance/audit: we need a certified copy of the post-maintenance audit (signed hash of logs) for our SOC-2 records. Can you confirm the retention policy for the capture bucket and the sign-off process?
- Emergency contact: please loop in our infra lead Jasmine Park (jasmine.park@acmeai.com) for the live window.

We are leaning toward the weekend window (July 17) to minimize user impact, pending a short rehearse on stage the week before. Can you provide a short checklist for what we should test during the rehearsal?

Regards,
Samantha
Head of Platform
Acme AI

Team,

Security quick checks and additions:
- Audit & retention: confirm S3 bucket encryption (AES-256) + KMS CMK with rotation. Retain post-window capture for 90 days by default; Acme can request extended retention via a ticket. We'll snapshot the log hash and store the signed hash in DocuSign (see related_links).
- Access: tighten who can trigger rollback automation — only SRE owners + named customer SOC rep (if requested). We'll require MFA + session attestations for rollback.
- Data plane TLS: ensure mutual TLS handshake is validated after the upgrade (some on-prem connectors use custom CA certs). We'll include a TLS handshake check in the canary step.
- Compliance rehearsal: require one signed rehearsal run (stage) and an evidence bundle (screenshots, logs, signed checklist) 48 hours before window. That evidence bundle must be uploaded to the shared runbook link.

I'll add these to v3.1 and mark the rehearsal gating criteria.

Mina
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps:

Decisions made:
- Maintenance window: provisional weekend slot confirmed — July 17 02:00–10:00 PT. Acme will share final confirmation by EOD Monday.
- Rehearsal: stage rehearse scheduled for July 9. Must produce signed evidence bundle 48 hours prior (per Mina).
- Pinning: pinned tenants will opt out of the bulk rollout. We'll provide console opt-in and a skipped-tenants artifact.
- Rollback automation: Dev will deliver automation for routing flip + actor restart by July 2; snapshot restore remains manual unless a prior snapshot is present.
- Audit: logs retained 90 days by default, KMS CMK in place, signed hash to be stored in DocuSign.

Alex action items:
- Publish v3.1 runbook (including Dev/Mina updates) by Monday 21:00 PT and send the official maintenance announcement notice to Acme.
- Create the rehearsal checklist and share the test plan link.

Acme action items:
- Confirm final window and provide contact Jasmine Park for live escalation.
- Approve the rehearsal checklist or propose additions by June 22.

Please reply with any objections; otherwise I'll treat this as the plan and proceed to scheduling and doc updates.

Best,
